segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Community bank providing deposits and commercial, residential and consumer loans to customers in New York and Pennsylvania.
segments.evidence: The Corporation has identified separate operating segments and internal financial information is primarily reported and aggregated in two lines of business, banking and wealth management services.

segments.name: Wealth management services
segments.description: Provides wealth management, insurance, mutual fund, brokerage and benefit plan services through the Bank's WMG and CFS subsidiary.
segments.evidence: The Corporation established a financial services subsidiary, CFS, in September 2001 which offers non-banking financial services such as mutual funds, annuities, brokerage services, insurance, and tax preparation services.

revenueModel.text: The Bank earns income primarily from interest and fees on loans, interest on investment securities, wealth management fee income, and fees from deposit and other services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Bank derives its income primarily from interest and fees on loans, interest on investment securities, WMG fee income, and fees received in connection with deposit and other services.
